title: Graceful connection reaper and hedged-retry stabilization (hotpatch)
author: Amelia Park
description:
Motivation: During a regional traffic surge we observed a compounding failure mode where long-lived streaming/gRPC connections were occasionally left in an indeterminate state (backend shard restart + half-closed client streams). Orphaned streams kept KV caches pinned and worker slots occupied; at the same time the hedged-retry path was triggering retries with insufficient jitter which multiplied load and pushed regional p99 latency above the SLO. This PR introduces a conservative connection reaper plus hedged-retry backoff tuning to prevent recreation storms and free stuck resources quickly.

What this change does: 1) Adds a connection reaper that detects streams with depleted heartbeats or no progress for a configurable TTL and gracefully drains them (emit a Disconnect event, release KV cache handles, increment reaper metrics). 2) Adds an exponential-jitter cap to hedged-retries and a sliding window rate-limit that prevents more than N hedged attempts per tenant per-second. 3) Introduces a safety gate: if reaper-triggered disconnects exceed a threshold we ramp hedged-retry suppression to avoid correlated fallback storms. 4) Adds telemetry (reaper.count, reaper.duration_ms, hedged_retry.suppressed_count, hedged_retry.jitter_ms_hist) and dashboards/alerts for SLO impact.

Rollback and safety: feature is behind runtime flags and defaults to conservative settings. Reaper TTL is 30s in the default hotpatch profile, hedged retry jitter floor of 50ms and cap 500ms. We also added a canary rollout plan to 10% of region instances, with auto-rollback when p99 increases or reaper disconnects spike >0.5% of requests in a 10m window.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc (link: Linear ENG-9786) - [x] Unit tests for reaper detection and release semantics - [x] Integration test that simulates backend shard restart + client half-close - [x] Telemetry + dashboards - [x] Canary rollout config and rollback thresholds - [x] Post-merge incident note template prepared

Testing notes: Local sim harness exercised 10k concurrent streams, induced backend restarts; reaper reclaimed stuck streams within expected TTL and hedged retry suppression prevented retry amplification. CI required a second integration run to stabilize flakiness in the streaming test harness (see CI comments).

Why this is different from previous changes: Prior PRs focused on tenant-level soft-quarantine and load-shedding; this PR targets the lower-level resource leak that can exacerbate those mechanisms. Fixing the leak reduces pressure on eviction and SLO throttlers and prevents cascading failover.

Related: Linear ENG-9786, SRE-1023, incident INT-549.

review_comments: Ravi Kapoor (reviewer): Overall looks reasonable. Two immediate questions: 1) can reaper falsely kill long-poll streams under high GC pauses? 2) what's the expected cost of per-tenant rate limiter memory?

Amelia Park (author): For 1) reaper honors an in-process 'progress' token updated by any successful read/write; GC pause could delay that, so we set conservative defaults (30s TTL) and only enable in canary by default. For 2) limiter uses a compact leaky-bucket with TTL on entries; with defaults it costs ~200B per active tenant slot — we measured <10MB in our 10k stream sim. I'll add a note to the ops doc.
Leah Chen (reviewer): Unit tests look good. Integration test still flakes on CI occasionally — suggest instrumenting the harness with retry hooks rather than increasing global timeouts.
Amelia Park (author): Agreed; switched to targeted retry hooks for the test and kept overall timeout unchanged. Pushed change in commit 4.
Miguel Santos (SRE): Add an alert that triggers when reaper.disconnect_rate > 0.2% AND p99 latency increased >10% in 5m. We don't want silent mass kills without human in the loop.
Amelia Park (author): Added dashboard panel and alert rule in ops/dashboards and configs/canary; backoff suppression also trips if disconnect_rate > 0.5% as an automated guard.

release_notes: Hotpatch: fix for orphaned streaming connections and hedged-retry amplification. Adds connection reaper and hedged-retry suppression to reduce SLO breaches during shard restarts. Safe defaults and canary rollout included.
